'''Kenev''' was a member of [[Lema Xandret]]'s colony on [[Sebaddon]] and served aboard the ''[[Cinzia]]''. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Marg Sar]] and Kenev encountered a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] and blew up their ship, and themselves, in order to the ship's cargo a secret.
